overview: The Residential Quarter is the living heart of Sanctus Seru, where citizens reside under strict doctrinal oversight.
history: Built during Seru’s earliest expansion to house loyal citizens.
Purity-screened apartments were added to prevent ideological corruption.
Resonance utilities were integrated to ensure doctrinal alignment.
Praetorian patrol routes were formalized to maintain order.
hooks: A purity apartment reports a resonance anomaly.
A communal hall experiences a doctrine flare.
A Praetorian patrol requests assistance with a citizen compliance issue.
A resident disappears under suspicious circumstances.
